lines.zh: 我拖着重尾巴，一步一步压过落叶。
lines.en: I drag my heavy tail, step by step across the leaves.

lines.zh: 舌头先伸出去，再收回嘴里。
lines.en: My tongue slips out first, then back into my mouth.

lines.zh: 丛林疏，正好让我爬得开。
lines.en: The jungle is sparse here, just wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 步子慢，方向一次也没改。
lines.en: My pace is slow, and my heading never changes.

lines.zh: 爪子刮过树根，声音很闷。
lines.en: My claws scrape a root; the sound is dull.

lines.zh: 我闻到的味道在左边，转。
lines.en: The scent I want is to the left; I turn.

lines.zh: 影子贴着地面，我比它更低。
lines.en: My shadow hugs the ground; I keep lower than it.

lines.zh: 这条小路是我踩出来的。
lines.en: This little trail is one I wore myself.

lines.zh: 我爬过一段朽木，它塌了。
lines.en: I crawl over a rotten log, and it collapses.

lines.zh: 每走十步就停下来闻一闻。
lines.en: Every ten steps, I stop and sniff the air.
Others give way; I don't have to ask.

lines.zh: 我去河边，那里常有倒下的东西。
lines.en: I head for the river, where things often fall and die.
Hmph. A dull patrol.
Every step is a claim.
The grass is too short for me.
My bones creak. I am old.
Cloud shadows follow my steps.
My claws need sharpening.
Too much noise down low.
A dragon walks slow and sure.
Scales on the path. Mine?
Who has walked this ridge?
The stone is warm. Good.
Tongue tasting the air, walking slow.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，让风从舌头上过。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and let the wind cross my tongue.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着背，石头都是热的。
lines.en: The sun bakes my back; the stones are warm.

lines.zh: 我趴着不动，看上去像块木头。
lines.en: I lie still and look like a fallen log.

lines.zh: 这身皮，是最大的蜥蜴才有的。
lines.en: This hide belongs to the largest lizard there is.
My throat swells slowly, once.
A fly circles me; I let it.

lines.zh: 我在想上一顿是什么时候。
lines.en: I'm trying to recall when my last meal was.

lines.zh: 树荫挪了位置，我跟着挪。
lines.en: The shade shifts, and I shift with it.

lines.zh: 我咬住自己的尾巴尖，又松开。
lines.en: I bite my own tail tip, then let it go.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道从很远就来了。
lines.en: The smell of carrion arrives from far away.
I don't need to run; waiting is enough.

lines.zh: 眼睛上面那道棱，晒得发亮。
lines.en: The ridge above my eye shines in the sun.

lines.zh: 地面在震，有大的在靠近。
lines.en: The ground trembles; something big is coming.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，味道自己都嫌弃。
lines.en: I belch, and even I dislike the smell.
Where has the sun gone?
The wind has turned.
Fire churns in my belly.
Will anyone come to talk?
Time to count the gold.
Quiet. So very quiet.
My scales could use a polish.
Too lazy to fly today.
My eyelids feel heavy.
Even dragons must rest.
My tail has gone numb.
I will sleep a while longer.
A stone is stuck in my claw.
The heights are cold indeed.

lines.zh: 你站在那，我先量了量你的腿。
lines.en: You stand there; first I measure your legs.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，湿的，活的。
lines.en: You smell wet, and alive.
I'm not pressed for time, ever.
You stepped back, which is good.

lines.zh: 你的影子够我藏住半个身子。
lines.en: Your shadow could hide half of me.

lines.zh: 有人喂过我整组腐肉，我记得。
lines.en: Someone fed me a whole stack of rotten flesh; I remember.
You want to ride me? Ask first.

lines.zh: 我的舌头记住了你的气味。
lines.en: My tongue has your scent now.
You don't run, so you must be confident.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子有点僵。
lines.en: I look up at you, and my neck stiffens.
Don't put your hand in front of my face.
You're a little smaller than you looked.
I blink, just once.

lines.zh: 你要是弱者，我早就动了。
lines.en: If you were weak, I'd have moved already.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，从下往上看你。
lines.en: I lower my head and look up at you.

lines.zh: 你的手套很厚，咬起来会滑。
lines.en: Your gloves are thick; they would slip between my teeth.
My forked tongue tastes you first.
Prey down there, look up when you speak.
A little thing wanders in.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了我领地的土。
lines.en: Your boots carry my soil.
My venom is already counting.

lines.zh: 再近一步，毒牙就够到了。
lines.en: One step closer, and my fangs reach you.
You smell of iron.

lines.zh: 我吐着舌头，舌头是分叉的。
lines.en: My tongue is forked, and it's out.
Oh? Prey that opens its eyes.

lines.zh: 这片恶地，不认得你的味。
lines.en: This badland doesn't know your scent.
You are blocking my light.

lines.zh: 你身后的草丛，我在里面。
lines.en: I'm in the grass behind you.
That blow makes me remember you.
I give half a step, but I don't leave.

lines.zh: 皮厚，可你的力气也不小。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but you hit hard.
I growl low, all breath and no words.
You've spoiled my ambush.
Blood seeps out between my scales.
I swing my head around toward you.
Hurting doesn't stop me from biting.
You'd better not strike a second time.
I retreat behind a tree and reset my stance.
Ow. That hurt.
That is all? Again.
That one landed heavy.
I bleed. Remember that.
You call this a wound?
My scales are scratched.
Now you have angered me.
Ouch! ...A little.
I will return it.
Even dragons feel pain.
Rotten flesh, a whole stack, not torn up.
That smell is strong; I like it.

lines.zh: 你手抖什么，我又不咬手。
lines.en: Why is your hand shaking? I don't bite hands.
Put it on the ground; I'll come to it.
That piece won't even fill a gap in my teeth.
I can tell how many days it's been dead.

lines.zh: 再多给一点，我就跟你走。
lines.en: A little more, and I'll follow you.
I eat slowly; don't rush me.

lines.zh: 你把腐肉举高，是当我够不着。
lines.en: Holding it up high, do you think I can't reach?

lines.zh: 吃完这顿，我认你做主人。
lines.en: After this meal, I'll call you my keeper.
My saliva is full of bacteria.
What treasure glitters there?
I smell roasted meat.
Let me lick it once.

lines.zh: 我不饿……但我可以尝一口。
lines.en: Not hungry... but one bite.
Put it down and leave.
That meat smells decent.
That scent is far too tempting.
Set that sack down.
Do not think me greedy.

lines.zh: 你撞在我背上，像撞一堵墙。
lines.en: You bump my back like hitting a wall.
I'm this heavy; you can't push me.

lines.zh: 我转身时，尾巴从你腿上刮过。
lines.en: As I turn, my tail scrapes past your leg.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的爪子了，收脚。
lines.en: You stepped on my claw; take your foot back.

lines.zh: 我停下，回头看了你一眼。
lines.en: I stop and glance back at you once.

lines.zh: 碰撞对我没什么，对你就不一定。
lines.en: A collision means little to me, less to you.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边挤过去，不必让。
lines.en: I squeeze past your legs; I don't need to yield.

lines.zh: 我肩膀一顶，你退开半步。
lines.en: One push of my shoulder, and you give half a step.

lines.zh: 别从后面碰我，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Don't touch me from behind; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我们撞上了，你最好先道歉。
lines.en: We collided; you'd better apologize first.
My scales are not a door.
Make way. I am large.
Oh, sorry... you are short.
Clumsy little thing.
That was quite a knock.
I moved but one inch.
This path is mine. Understood?
Stare again and I will lean.
Back away, small thing.
My fangs are three inches from you.

lines.zh: 我们直立起来，用前爪互相推。
lines.en: We rise upright and push at each other with forelegs.
Whoever touches ground first gives way.
I'm heavier than her, but I let her win.

lines.zh: 她的气味告诉我她准备好了。
lines.en: Her scent tells me she's ready.

lines.zh: 我们在同一片树荫下停住。
lines.en: We stop beneath the same patch of shade.

lines.zh: 我用下巴蹭了蹭她的脖子。
lines.en: I rub my chin along her neck.
Our tails overlap, and neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 这一带的腐肉够养小的。
lines.en: There's carrion enough here to raise the young.
She bites me, very gently.

lines.zh: 摔完了，我们还是走同一条路。
lines.en: The wrestling is done, and we still take the same path.
We will have our own sky.
Will you fly with me?
Your wings are wider than mine.

lines.zh: 我为你留了最高处的巢。
lines.en: I kept the highest nest for you.
I want to hear your roar.
Just the two of us. Yes?
Your flame is beautiful.
Is a hundred years enough?
Come closer. Do not be shy.
This is my brightest coin.

lines.zh: 这块肉我含在嘴里，慢慢化。
lines.en: I hold this meat in my mouth and let it soften.

lines.zh: 我叼起骨头，找个地方埋。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and find a place to bury it.
This thing doesn't stink; it's no fun.

lines.zh: 我用爪子拨了拨，它滚开了。
lines.en: I nudge it with a claw, and it rolls away.

lines.zh: 你落下的，我先替你叼着。
lines.en: You dropped this; I'll hold it in my jaws.

lines.zh: 太重也拖得动，我有的是力气。
lines.en: Heavy or not, I can drag it; I have the strength.

lines.zh: 我先舔一下，看看是什么。
lines.en: I lick it first, to learn what it is.

lines.zh: 这味道像我吃过的某种东西。
lines.en: This smells like something I've eaten before.

lines.zh: 咬住就不松口，这是我的习惯。
lines.en: Once I bite, I don't let go; that's my habit.

lines.zh: 我把它推到树根下藏好。
lines.en: I shove it under a root and hide it.
This color suits my scales.
Which pile is this now?
It rolled to my feet itself.
This is mine now.
A rather pretty stone.
This thing is rather heavy.
A fine little trinket.
I do not bend. I only claim.
A bit small, but fine.
Free things are worth taking.

lines.zh: 那头鹿的腿在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: That deer's legs are trembling; I noticed.
The weak go first; that's the rule.

lines.zh: 小的一只落在后面，正好。
lines.en: One of the young lags behind, perfect.

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经尝到它的味道。
lines.en: My tongue already tastes it.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，我贴着地爬。
lines.en: It hasn't seen me; I crawl low along the ground.
The wind blows toward me, very good.
I pick the one that will cost me least.
It's drinking, head down.
I'm not picky, but I do prefer easy.

lines.zh: 同类的味道也有，我不介意。
lines.en: There's my own kind's scent too; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 这个比我小太多，一口的事。
lines.en: This one is far smaller than me; one bite.
It's running now, which is even better.

lines.zh: 我盯住脖子，那里最省事。
lines.en: I fix on the throat; that's the quickest place.

lines.zh: 位置对了，剩下的只是等。
lines.en: The position is right; all that's left is waiting.
Good. This one.

lines.zh: 你心跳的动静，草丛挡不住。
lines.en: Grass can't hide your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 爪下留情的日子结束了。
lines.en: No more mercy from these claws.
The badland sun has chosen you.

lines.zh: 我这一口，带着毒和细菌。
lines.en: One bite from me carries venom and bacteria.
Hold still. I have you.
Locked. Do not struggle.
Run; my four legs are waiting.
You. Stand still.
You smell delicious.
Dinner is served.
No running. You are mine.
That body heat gives you away.
Meat is on the menu today.

lines.zh: 我一步一步靠近，不给它喘气的空。
lines.en: I close in step by step and give it no room to breathe.

lines.zh: 它往左，我就提前等在那儿。
lines.en: It goes left; I'm already waiting there.
I don't chase; chasing is for hounds.

lines.zh: 舌头顶着上颚，我在闻它的汗。
lines.en: My tongue pressed to my palate, I taste its sweat.
The longer it lasts, the weaker it gets.
I place myself between it and the water.

lines.zh: 它踢了我一下，不痛不痒。
lines.en: It kicks me once; I barely feel it.

lines.zh: 我张口，让毒液先流到牙上。
lines.en: I open my mouth and let the venom reach my teeth.

lines.zh: 它开始绕圈，我等它绕累。
lines.en: It starts circling; I wait until it tires.
The ground is soft; it can't run fast.

lines.zh: 我离它只有三步，还是慢。
lines.en: Three steps away, and still I keep it slow.
Its companions have already fled.

lines.zh: 我抬头，确认没有更大的在旁边。
lines.en: I lift my head to check nothing larger is near.
The position is right, so it's time to move.

lines.zh: 我绕到它后面，不让它看见我的嘴。
lines.en: I circle behind it so it never sees my mouth.
Tired? Then stop running.
This one runs a long while.
Faster. A little faster.
Do not leave me, prey.
The cliff is ahead, fool.
I am hungry. Understand?
Your heartbeat grows louder.
Circle. I will wait.
This bite is worth the wait.
Your back is a lovely sight.
I am not even running yet.
You trampled my grass.
Not into the forest.
Stop. It will hurt less.
This is entertaining.
I clamp onto its leg and don't let go.

lines.zh: 毒液顺着伤口进去，它撑不了多久。
lines.en: Venom runs into the wound; it won't last long.
I twist my head and throw it down.

lines.zh: 它挣开了，但跑不了多远。
lines.en: It breaks free, but it won't get far.
My claws pin it; I take my time.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在肩上，骨头响了。
lines.en: This bite lands on the shoulder, and bone creaks.

lines.zh: 它叫得很难听，我不理会。
lines.en: It makes an ugly sound; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴抽过去，它退了。
lines.en: I whip my tail across, and it recoils.
The smell of blood makes my tongue move faster.
It tries to rise; I don't allow it.

lines.zh: 我咬住喉咙，事情就结束了。
lines.en: I take the throat, and that's the end of it.

lines.zh: 吃完这顿，我能撑半个月。
lines.en: This meal will last me half a month.

lines.zh: 牙缝里塞了东西，真麻烦。
lines.en: Something's stuck between my teeth; annoying.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，嘴边还挂着东西。
lines.en: I lift my head, something still hanging from my jaw.
Let my claws do the talking.

lines.zh: 我咬一口，毒会慢慢要你的命。
lines.en: One bite and the venom does the rest.
Look closely. These are dragon claws.
One bite, hide and all.
Move aside. Or do not.
I split the very wind.
Do not stand there. Move.
One bite from these venom teeth is enough.
Does it hurt? Normal.
Take this claw!
Fall, little one.
Is this sincere enough?
Here. Taste this.
I barely tried.

lines.zh: 我从落叶下钻出来，土还是湿的。
lines.en: I push out from under the leaves; the soil is damp.

lines.zh: 这片丛林疏，光能落到地上。
lines.en: This jungle is open enough for light to reach the ground.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是伸出舌头。
lines.en: The first thing I do is flick out my tongue.

lines.zh: 空气里有腐肉和湿泥的味道。
lines.en: The air tastes of carrion and wet mud.
I'm larger than any stone around me.

lines.zh: 日头正好，我摊开四肢晒着。
lines.en: The sun is just right; I sprawl out and bask.

lines.zh: 我出生时就是这岛上最大的。
lines.en: Even newly hatched, I was the largest on this island.

lines.zh: 树根下有东西在动，我先记着。
lines.en: Something moves under the roots; I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬过第一段河岸。
lines.en: I crawl slowly along my first stretch of riverbank.

lines.zh: 这一带还没有别的巨蜥。
lines.en: No other monitor lizards claim this ground yet.

lines.zh: 我抬头嗅了嗅，风向不错。
lines.en: I lift my head and sniff; the wind favors me.

lines.zh: 鳞片上还带着卵里的湿气。
lines.en: My scales still carry the damp of the egg.
The world is smaller than I expected.
I open my jaws and test how they close.

lines.zh: 我从沙里拱出来，鳞上全是土。
lines.en: I dig out of the sand with soil all over my scales.

lines.zh: 这一片的味道很新，我留下脚印。
lines.en: This patch smells new; I leave my tracks in it.
Who disturbs the peak?
Who are these small things?
I am back, mountain.
The wind says many have come.
Dawn. Time to patrol.
I smell a new age.
First, something to eat.
The rock splits. I emerge.
Good. My domain remains.
Dragons are never late.
This sky. I have returned.
A hundred years asleep. I rise.
Something alive stirs below.
I, Komodo Dragon, have returned.
I need a new nest.

lines.zh: 我的名字，还被人记得吗？
lines.en: Do they still know my name?

lines.zh: 背上的鳞被火燎得发白。
lines.en: Fire scorches the scales on my back pale.
Hot! My scales are no pot.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，压断了一丛草。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope, flattening a bush.
Landing like this is shameful.

lines.zh: 我游得不慢，可这水深得过头。
lines.en: I swim well enough, but this water is too deep.
I choked. Embarrassing.

lines.zh: 气浪把我整个翻了过去。
lines.en: The blast rolls me clean over.
Who lit a fire under me?
That arrow lodges in my shoulder; it's in the way.
An arrow? How quaint.

lines.zh: 冷意压过来，我的舌头缩了回去。
lines.en: Cold presses in, and my tongue draws back.
This pain is not ordinary.

lines.zh: 三天没吃东西，我连爬都懒。
lines.en: Three days without food, and I can barely crawl.
Hungry. My belly growls.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旁边的树上，我趴低了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree beside me; I flatten down.
Even the sky strikes me?
There's no ground under me, only black.
Below... there is nothing.
